$comment: REFERENCE COPY — the demo's map, part of example/, not of the harness.
Nothing reads this file. format.py reads $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/format.map.json,
so the live map is one you write in your own project; a missing map
disables auto-formatting silently, exactly like a missing formatter.
This copy exists to show the shape: format.py walks rules in order and runs
the first one whose prefix and extension match the file just written.
prefix matches the path relative to the PROJECT ROOT, anchored at its start:
'frontend/' is frontend/ at the top level, never vendor/legacy/frontend/.
'' matches every file in the project, and never one outside it.
requires is a binary that must be on PATH, or the rule is skipped.
